note: C10-2 nightly analysis (C10-C). Once a day, separate from the resident Threads worker. budget is an analysis budget (about 80 candidates), not a quota: fewer candidates are fine and nothing is padded. Analysis reads local and cached data only; anything that needs a new external fetch is grouped per provider into a refresh plan (never called by the batch). The Windows scheduled task was registered on 2026-09-30 (human-approved, C10-2 activation; interactive logon like the other project tasks). Changing it is a human decision.
